name: The Westin Grand Cayman Seven Mile Beach Resort & Spa

address.street: 30620 Seven Mile Beach Grand Cayman KY1

insider_take: Seven Mile Beach isn't actually seven miles long – it's closer to 5.5 miles, but don't let that fool you into thinking it's any less spectacular.
whats_special: The Westin sits on what's consistently ranked as one of the world's best beaches, where the sand is so fine it squeaks under your feet. This stretch of coastline boasts some of the clearest Caribbean waters you'll find, perfect for spotting stingrays just offshore. The resort's location puts you at the heart of Grand Cayman's prestigious Seven Mile Beach corridor, where luxury meets laid-back island vibes.
pro_tip: Visit Stingray City Sandbar early morning when the water is calmest and the stingrays are most active – it's just a 30-minute boat ride from the resort's beach.
dont_miss: The famous "Barefoot Man" beach performances that happen right on Seven Mile Beach, and be sure to time your stay around a clear night to witness some of the most brilliant stargazing in the Caribbean – Grand Cayman's minimal light pollution makes for incredible celestial views from the beach.
pros: Prime location on world-famous Seven Mile Beach
Full-service Hibiscus Spa with signature treatments
Multiple dining venues including beachfront restaurants
Westin Heavenly Beds and premium amenities
cons: Premium Caribbean pricing reflects luxury positioning
Popular location can be busy during peak seasons
